title: Automatic Sync and Seamless Cloud Passwords
summary: Real-time automatic background sync across devices and one-step Passwords setup for Ottero Cloud accounts.

sections.title: New
items: Automatic background sync on sign-in, local edits, window focus, and real-time WebSocket push notices across devices.
Multi-device Passwords sync: signing into your Ottero Cloud account on a new device unlocks your synced vault automatically.

sections.title: Improved
items: Cloud-linked Passwords now open immediately with your single Account Emergency Kit — no redundant second recovery key step.
Encrypted vault backups and archives work seamlessly for Cloud-linked vaults.

title: Ottero Cloud, 2FA, and Encrypted Sync
summary: Optional Ottero Cloud accounts with authenticator two-step verification, zero-knowledge end-to-end encrypted sync, and subscription management.

sections.title: New
items: Ottero Cloud accounts in Settings → Account with Secret Key sign-in, printable Emergency Kit, and device session management.
Authenticator app two-step verification (TOTP) with 10 single-use backup codes.
Link Passwords to your Ottero account so one unlock opens both, with idle and sleep auto-lock.
End-to-end encrypted sync engine (XChaCha20-Poly1305) with non-blocking Sync now and command palette action.
Upgrade to Ottero Cloud and manage billing directly from Settings → Account.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Hardened Emergency Kit and vault backup file permissions.
Improved vault unlock error recovery and cleared sensitive buffers on lock and sign-out.

title: Calmfold is now Ottero
summary: A new name and icon. Your notes, tasks, vault and settings come with you.

sections.title: Improved
items: Calmfold is now Ottero by Nexdark Labs, with a new app icon.
Your data folder, database, vault and theme choice move over on first launch; nothing to export or re-import.
Installed Calmfold copies update to Ottero in place, and older vault backups still open.

title: More room for your work
summary: Projects, focused sessions and a workspace that fits the way you work.

sections.title: New
items: Developer workspace with project links, setup notes, tasks and encrypted environment sets.
Focus timer with task linking and reliable mode switching.
Choose which features appear in the sidebar, their order and your startup page.

sections.title: Improved
items: Native in-app updates with Sparkle on Mac and Velopack on Windows, authenticated downloads and save-before-restart protection.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Vault and environment editing improvements, with safer imports, exports and draft preservation.

title: Small details, smoother days
summary: A few refinements for everyday use.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Windows: the sidebar and note-list buttons in the title bar now respond to the mouse.
Windows: the empty notes hint on Today says Ctrl+N instead of ⌘N.
Smaller and faster development builds.

sections.title: New
items: First release for Windows and macOS.
Notes with live Markdown, links between notes, tags, math and diagrams.
Tasks with quick add, repeats, subtasks and projects.
Calendar with month, week, day and agenda views, .ics import, holidays for about 245 countries, birthdays and anniversaries.
Habits with streaks and insights.
An encrypted password vault with one-time codes, a generator, a recovery key and encrypted backups.
